column3: “as long as you live on the earth” renders “all the days you are alive on the land.”
“utterly destroy” renders the doubled verb “surely destroy”; “green” renders “luxuriant.”
NASB supplies “the LORD” as the object of “seek”; the Hebrew reads “you shall seek to His dwelling.” “establish” renders “put.”
“choice votive offerings” renders “the choicest of your votive offerings.”
“whatever you desire” renders “in all the desire of your soul.”
“You are not allowed” renders “You will not be able.”
“them” is plural for the Hebrew singular “it.”
“forsake” renders “neglect”; “as long as you live” renders “all your days.”
“promised” renders “spoke”; “because you desire” renders “for your appetite desires.”
